photos.caption: NASA's video, clock 11:03:50
photos.how: Frame from NASA's video at 1552 s; on-screen clock 04/10/13 11:03:50, wanted 11:03:50 (within 20 s; the matrix time plus one day). NASA's as-run matrix gives this test's start as 'GMT 13-099   11:03' on 2013-04-09 (`as run matrix!B95`), read as 2013-04-09 11:03. The video's on-screen clock reads one day later than the matrix on every day both cover, the same kind of offset NASA states for this clock on BASS-II, so the clock was searched for 2013-04-09 plus one day, 11:03: it was found 1502 s into this video, and in no other video. The fan setting on screen (62) is one the matrix's fan cell gives ('62,  98, 62, 42, off', `as run matrix!J95`).
